title: Set up Cloudflare redirect: ms-navigator.eu → ms-navigator.bg
description: Register ms-navigator.eu on Cloudflare (free plan). Point ms-navigator.eu nameservers to Cloudflare. Create a single Redirect Rule: ms-navigator.eu/* → https://ms-navigator.bg/$1 (301 permanent). See docs/guides/cloudflare-eu-redirect.md for full step-by-step guide.

title: Switch primary domain to ms-navigator.bg
description: Update astro.config.mjs site to 'https://ms-navigator.bg' and public/CNAME to 'ms-navigator.bg'. Update GitHub Pages custom domain setting to ms-navigator.bg. Add DNS A records for ms-navigator.bg pointing to GitHub Pages IPs (185.199.108-111.153). See docs/guides/cloudflare-eu-redirect.md for full guide.

title: Connect to GitHub and push
description: Add remote origin github.com/coldsoul/ms-navigator, push main, verify Actions workflow runs and site deploys. Configure custom domain ms-navigator.bg in GitHub Pages settings and add DNS A records. See plan Task 13.

title: GitHub Actions deployment workflow
description: Create .github/workflows/deploy.yml: build+type-check on PRs, build+deploy to GitHub Pages on main. Uses actions/checkout@v4, setup-node@v4, upload-pages-artifact@v3, deploy-pages@v4. See plan Task 12.

title: Public assets — CNAME and favicon
description: Create public/CNAME containing 'ms-navigator.bg' and public/favicon.svg (teal circle). Add favicon link to BaseLayout. See plan Task 11.

title: Eleven section pages
description: Create src/pages/*.astro for all 11 sections (kakvo-e-ms, vidove-ms, pristap, simptomi, izsledvania, lechenie, meditsinski-ekip, hranene-i-dieti, sharlatani, emotsii, chesti-vaprosi). Each uses getEntry from content collection. Verify all 11 routes exist in dist/ after build. See plan Task 10.

title: Content Collection — schema and 11 Markdown placeholders
description: Create src/content/config.ts (sections collection, schema: title+summary). Create src/content/sections/*.md for all 11 sections with placeholder headings and frontmatter. See plan Task 9.

title: SectionLayout component
description: Create src/components/SectionLayout.astro: BackButton + h1 + summary + prose slot + Disclaimer at bottom. Uses @tailwindcss/typography for markdown rendering. See plan Task 7.

title: Home page — index.astro
description: Final home page: header with dot logo, h1 hero, Disclaimer, 2-column card grid with all 11 SectionCards, footer. Compare visually with documents/ms-navigator-homepage.html. See plan Task 8.

title: Disclaimer and BackButton components
description: Create src/components/Disclaimer.astro (amber warning box) and BackButton.astro (← link with 48px tap target). See plan Task 5.

title: SectionCard component
description: Create src/components/SectionCard.astro with icon/title/description/arrow, hover lift+border+shadow, focus-visible ring, staggered animation via animationDelay prop. See plan Task 6.

title: BaseLayout.astro
description: Create HTML shell with meta/OG tags, Google Fonts, skip-to-content link, analytics comment slot. Verify dev server renders warm background and fonts. See plan Task 4.

title: Install Astro and Tailwind
description: npm install astro @astrojs/tailwind tailwindcss @tailwindcss/typography, create astro.config.mjs and src/env.d.ts. See plan Task 2.

title: Tailwind design tokens
description: Write full theme in tailwind.config.mjs: colors, fonts, custom breakpoint, fade-in-up animation. See plan Task 3.

title: Repo foundation — git, .gitignore, npm, beads
description: Initialize git repo, create .gitignore and package.json, run bd init. See plan Task 1 in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-04-25-ms-navigator.md
